result.summary: Modular-Monolith architecture with 4 services on None (Local Deployment)

output.overview: The system is designed to automate the verification of raw artifacts in the stage1 output of a software pipeline, ensuring they meet predefined quality and completeness criteria. It emphasizes low latency, high security, and scalability to handle increasing artifact volumes.

services.name: Artifact Verification Service
services.responsibility: Automates the verification of artifacts against predefined quality criteria.

services.name: Logging and Monitoring Service
services.responsibility: Tracks verification process and outcomes, providing observability.

services.name: Notification Service
services.responsibility: Notifies users of verification results and allows configuration of preferences.

services.name: Metadata Repository
services.responsibility: Stores metadata for each artifact to support verification and traceability.

auto_scaling_rules: Scale out when CPU usage > 70% for 5 minutes
Scale in when CPU usage < 30% for 10 minutes

data_flow.description: Stores verification results and metadata for each artifact.
Sends logs and metrics for verification activities.
Triggers notifications based on verification outcomes.
Delivers verification result notifications to users.

latency_optimizations: Use of in-memory caching with Redis to reduce database load.
Load balancing across multiple instances of services.

trade_offs.rationale: Simplifies deployment and management for local environments while maintaining modularity.
Avoids cloud costs and complexity for initial deployment, suitable for local testing.

trade_offs.decision: Use of PostgreSQL for metadata storage
trade_offs.rationale: Provides robust relational database capabilities with strong consistency.
